t: You're on Rosebery Avenue, a major thoroughfare running between the boroughs of Camden and Islington. It starts in the southwest at the junction with Theobald's Road in Holborn, and ends in the northeast at St John Street in Clerkenwell. Finsbury Town Hall and Charles Rowan House are among the buildings along it. The street is named after Archibald Primrose, the fifth Earl of Rosebery, a Liberal politician who served as Prime Minister from March 1894 to June 1895.
